entries.what: Elliot logs the 2 a.m. feed, then makes oat-milk coffee at Marisol Gardens unit 209 while Theo naps on his chest. Brenda's Monday check-in email lands around 8:15 a.m. and he reads it twice.
entries.outcome: He flags it to answer later and doesn't.

entries.what: Stroller walk on the Ulloa Salt Marsh boardwalk with Theo, who fusses at the squeaky front wheel.
entries.outcome: Theo falls asleep halfway back.

entries.what: Evening witching hour; Elliot hums the ballpark organ tune while Hana takes a turn. Takeout pho from Phở Bến Thành for dinner.
entries.outcome: Theo settles by 8 p.m.

entries.what: Elliot catches up on the log tabs and does a baby laundry load in the card-only laundry room that night. Hana mentions Thao's hospital switched to the new charting system today and Thao came home swearing at it.
entries.outcome: Laundry done, Thao gets a sympathetic nod in the hallway.

entries.what: Morning nap trial in the crib; Elliot sits outside the door timing it.
entries.outcome: A 50-minute nap, logged.

entries.what: Evening fussiness; Elliot walks the hallway past unit 211 quietly.
entries.outcome: No note taped to the door this time.

entries.what: Two-month shots at Dr. Fong's clinic in Plaza Marisol; Theo weighs 12 lb 3 oz. The next visit, a four-month well visit, is booked for Nov 19 at 9:40 a.m.
entries.outcome: Shots done, next appointment on the calendar.

entries.what: Theo is cranky and warm from the shots; Elliot gives the dose Dr. Fong approved and logs every feed.
entries.outcome: Short naps, extra contact holding.

entries.what: Evening takeout and a puzzle piece or two on the lighthouse jigsaw after Theo goes down.
entries.outcome: Three pieces placed.

entries.what: At 3 a.m. Elliot asks the assistant how to take over the 5 a.m. feed as well, 'just for a while', without telling Hana it's because she looks exhausted.
entries.outcome: He settles on telling her he's awake anyway.

entries.what: Thursday 10:30 baby story time at the library with Kaitlyn's group, Theo in the carrier.
entries.outcome: Theo smiles at the puppet; Elliot swaps tips in the parent chat.

entries.what: Afternoon crib nap, then Elliot leaves Brenda's email unanswered again.
entries.outcome: Email sits in drafts.

entries.what: Elliot takes both the 2 and 5 a.m. feeds and lets Hana sleep through.
entries.outcome: Hana wakes surprised and rested; he says he was up anyway.

entries.what: Stroller walk on the marsh boardwalk, then a Friday-night laundry load at the card-only machines.
entries.outcome: Clean onesies, an empty hamper.

entries.what: Elliot texts Gloria again about the leaking bathroom faucet in 209.
entries.outcome: No reply yet.

entries.what: Saturday morning grocery run to Ruiz Family Market with Theo in the carrier, delivery only for diapers.
entries.outcome: Comes home with groceries and a list of cheap meals.

entries.what: Elliot, Hana and Theo go to the Calle Ortega Street Fair for an hour, with pan dulce and live music, then leave when the crowd gets loud.
entries.outcome: Theo naps in the stroller through the band.

entries.what: Evening fussiness at home; Elliot scores it in baseball terms to Hana.
entries.outcome: Theo sleeps at 8:30 with the egret lovey.

entries.what: Slow Sunday morning; Elliot makes scrambled eggs and reviews the week's log tab.
entries.outcome: Notes more naps in the crib than last week.

entries.what: Afternoon at home while Hana naps; Elliot works on the jigsaw and rocks Theo.
entries.outcome: Theo gets his longest stretch yet.

entries.what: Sunday evening prep: Elliot packs the diaper bag and plans the week's feeds.
entries.outcome: Bag ready, lists made.
